source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR) Hyderabad
symptoms: Spindle-shaped or eye-shaped lesions with grayish centers and brown borders on leaves
Neck rot causing panicle breakage and chaffy grains

approved_remedies.name: Pseudomonas fluorescens 0.5% WP
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Foliar spray at early tillering and panicle initiation during morning hours.

approved_remedies.name: Balanced Nitrogen & Aeration
approved_remedies.approved_dosage: Avoid split nitrogen excess above 120 kg/ha
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Maintain 5 cm water depth without continuous stagnant inundation. Remove weed hosts on bunds.

contraindications: Do not spray copper fungicides during flowering/anthesis.

source: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) Nagpur
symptoms: Rosetted flowers that fail to open fully
Bore holes in green bolls plugged with excreta, damaged lint

approved_remedies.name: Gossyplure Pheromone Traps
approved_remedies.approved_dosage: 5 traps per acre for ETL monitoring; 10-15 traps for mass trapping
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Install traps 30 cm above canopy height. Replace lure septa every 21 days.

approved_remedies.name: Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoid
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Release 3 times at weekly intervals starting 45 days after sowing.

approved_remedies.name: Neem Oil 1500 ppm
approved_remedies.approved_dosage: 5 ml per liter of water with 1 ml liquid soap
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Spray during dusk on flower buds to repel egg laying.

contraindications: Do not apply broad-spectrum pyrethroids early in season as they induce resurgence.

symptoms: Third or fourth leaf from crown loses turgor and withers
Internal pith shows dark red lesions with diagnostic white cross-bands

approved_remedies.name: Trichoderma harzianum soil enrichment
approved_remedies.approved_dosage: 5 kg/acre mixed in 500 kg well-rotted FYM
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Incorporate at planting and at earthing up to colonize rhizosphere.

approved_remedies.name: Healthy Sett Selection & Moist Hot Air Treatment (MHAT)
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Rogue out entire infected clumps with roots and burn outside field. Avoid ratoon of infected crop.

contraindications: Do not recycle infected irrigation runoff to down-slope fields.

source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research (IIHR) Bengaluru
symptoms: Concentric ring 'target-board' brown/black spots on lower leaves
Yellow halos around circular lesions progressing upward

approved_remedies.name: Cow urine fermented with Neem and Pongamia leaves (Dashaparni)
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Foliar drench underside of leaves every 10 days.

approved_remedies.name: Bacillus subtilis 1% WP
approved_remedies.application_instructions: Spray at first appearance of target spots on lower foliage.

contraindications: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation that splashes soil spores onto foliage.
